description:
Splines: smooth or straight paths through points, optionally shown as a swept mesh (roads, rivers, walls, pipes).
Closed splines are areas for pcg.scatter (mode inside) and PCG graphs; open ones are paths.
name: spline

tools.description:
Creates a spline through world points, optionally shown as a mesh swept along it. Undoable.
Returns: The spline node, its length and whether it is closed.

closed.description: Closed loop: an area (forest, field, lake shore) instead of a path.

follow_ground.description: Drop each point onto the ground below before building the curve.

linear.description: Straight segments between points instead of a smooth curve (fences, walls, buildings).

parent.description: Optional parent node. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

points.description: World positions [x,y,z] in cm, at least 2 (e.g. [[0,0,0],[5000,2000,0],[9000,0,0]]).

profile.description: Mesh along the spline: {kind: ribbon|wall|tube|none, width, height, step, z_offset, material:{...}}.

height.description: Height in cm: ribbon thickness (default 8), wall height (default 300), tube lift above the path (default 0). Negative = default.

kind.description: What to sweep along the spline.

material.description: Builder material fields: {"material": "asphalt", "color": [r,g,b], "roughness": 0.8, ...} (same as build.create_assembly parts). (Any JSON value)

step.description: Distance between mesh rings in cm (smaller = smoother curves).

width.description: Width in cm (ribbon and wall width, tube diameter).

z_offset.description: Raise the mesh above the path (cm), e.g. to avoid z-fighting with the ground.

profile.title: RuntimeSplineProfile

tools.name: spline.create_spline

returnValue.description: The spline node, its length and whether it is closed.

closed.description: Whether the spline is a closed loop (an area).

length_cm.description: Length along the curve in cm.

spline.description: The spline node. Pass it to sample_spline, pcg tools or scene tools. (Actor (null if none))

ref.description: Pass this back to tools that take this object

returnValue.title: RuntimeSplineInfo

tools.description:
Samples points along a spline, for placing things along a path in scripts.
Returns: Length, closed flag and the samples (location, direction, yaw, distance).

spline.description: The spline node. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: spline.sample_spline

returnValue.description: Length, closed flag and the samples (location, direction, yaw, distance).

distance.description: Distance from the start in cm.

yaw.description: Yaw of the direction in degrees (rotate placed objects by this to face along the path).

returnValue.title: RuntimeSplineSamples
